name: _meta
script: return "删除旅行链路（暗色）：侧栏主题切换器切暗色 → 时间线删除城市夜行手册 → 确认弹窗与 toast。前置：gen-demo 演示数据。"

name: 02-click-dark
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role="radiogroup"][aria-label="主题"] button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '暗'); if (!b) throw new Error('暗色切换按钮缺失'); b.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); if (document.documentElement.dataset.theme !== 'dark') throw new Error('暗色未生效'); 'dark-ok'

name: 04-click-timeline-delete
script: const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(el => el.textContent.includes('城市夜行手册')); const btn = h?.closest('.relative.flex')?.querySelector('button[title="删除这次旅行"]'); if (!btn) throw new Error('找不到删除按钮'); btn.click(); 'clicked'

name: 06-confirm-delete
script: const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === '移入废纸篓'); if (!b) throw new Error('找不到确认按钮'); b.click(); 'confirmed'

name: 07-home-after-dark
script: const gone = ![...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].some(el => el.textContent.includes('城市夜行手册')); if (!gone) throw new Error('删除失败'); 'deleted-ok'
